scope: post-observation bounded within-bin exploratory pipeline calibration; no full-cache or independent-document p value
repair_scope: Same uniform D-mean constrained control law for every observed/null graph. No V-based selection, no draw dropping, no graph refitting.
original_sampling_H1b_missing_reason: Observed/null endpoint missing or Tb diagnostic qualification failed; no valid-only filtering
original_sampling_multiplicity: Two-endpoint family retained; missing H1b treated conservatively as p=1 solely for H1a adjustment, not an estimated H1b p
multiplicity: Two-endpoint exploratory family, Holm arithmetic on both approximate conditional p values; serial MCMC implies no guaranteed nominal FWER.
